# PostSpark

> AI content repurposing for creators and agencies. Turn one blog post, YouTube video, or PDF into 30+ ready-to-publish pieces — tweets, LinkedIn posts, email newsletters, and video scripts — in seconds.

PostSpark is a SaaS tool that uses AI (Claude, Gemini, GPT) to repurpose long-form content into multi-channel social posts. It supports brand voice training, brand kits, team workspaces, agency client approvals, scheduling, a public gallery, and a built-in blog/SEO toolkit.
